# Calvin Magezi

> Calvin Magezi is a Ugandan CTO, tech entrepreneur, and AI builder based in Kampala, Uganda.

## Who is Calvin Magezi?

Calvin Magezi is the Chief Technology Officer and co-founder of Kolaborate Platforms Limited and SiteSeer. He builds AI-powered software platforms focused on Africa's digital talent ecosystem and construction technology.

- **Full name**: Calvin Magezi
- **Role**: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
- **Location**: Kampala, Uganda
- **Companies**: Kolaborate Platforms Limited, SiteSeer
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/CalvinMagezi
- **Website**: https://calvinmagezi.github.io

## Projects

### Kolaborate
Africa's talent marketplace and BPO platform. Mission: "Africa's Engine for Global-Ready Digital Talent." Connects African tech talent with global opportunities through a pod-based team delivery model.

### SiteSeer
AI-powered construction and real estate technology platform. Includes Pango (Kenya home planning app), a Sales CRM, and the NCA Portal for Uganda's National Construction Authority.

### Chamuka
AI-powered collaborative diagramming tool. Uses Yjs/CRDT for real-time collaboration.

### Agent-HQ
Open-source local-first AI agent hub. Vault-centric multi-agent orchestration system built on Obsidian. Available at https://github.com/CalvinMagezi/agent-hq

## Technical Expertise

- TypeScript, Next.js, React, Bun runtime
- AI agent systems and orchestration
- Local-first software architecture
- Convex (real-time database), Vercel, Turborepo
- Mobile development (Expo/React Native)
- Construction tech and PropTech
